caution_findings.evidence_context: APD6 EC50 threshold wording is preserved as database activity annotation except for the CathEE-2a IC50 exact value supported by source text.
Supplementary Table 1 supports an 18-residue CathEE-3 with terminal Q and C-terminal amidation; APD6 sequence snapshot is a 17-residue string without that terminal residue/modification.
Methods report C-terminal amidation for all synthesized peptides; APD6 sequence strings do not encode the terminal modification.
The local text supports exact CathEE-2a IC50/CC50 and qualitative/statistical fixed-dose activity claims; exact bar heights for other qPCR panels were not text-recoverable and were not fabricated.
